svg.desc: LexisGuide, DOCKET, FORGE, Airlock and Semantic Output Cache - one row each, with what it is for, what it is built out of, and the test or evaluation number that can be checked in the repository. Typeset in Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
